name: Shiv Nadar

controls.name: HCL Technologies Ltd. (HCLTech)
controls.role: Founder (1976) and chairman emeritus/strategic advisor; handed the chair to his daughter Roshni Nadar Malhotra in 2020 and stepped down as MD in July 2021; promoter group controls HCLTech

vehicles.name: Vama Sundari Investments (Delhi) Pvt. Ltd.
vehicles.notes: Promoter holding company for the family's HCLTech stake. In March 2025 Shiv Nadar gifted 47% of his holding in Vama Delhi and HCL Corp to Roshni Nadar Malhotra, making her the largest shareholder.

vehicles.name: HCL Corporation Pvt. Ltd.
vehicles.notes: Promoter holding company; part of the March 2025 succession gift.

privateDeals.what: Shiv Nadar gifted 47% shareholdings in the HCL promoter entities (Vama Sundari Investments (Delhi) and HCL Corp) to daughter Roshni Nadar Malhotra, passing control of HCLTech to her (Mint, March 8, 2025).
HCLTech acquired HPE's Communications Technology Group assets for $225M.
HCLTech acquired data-management software firm Zeenea for EUR 24M.

giving.name: Shiv Nadar Foundation (India; the family donated Rs 2,708 crore through it in FY2025; Forbes counts $1.1B+ in lifetime giving to the foundation)
Shiv Nadar University and SSN College of Engineering (founded 1996)

watch.what: HCLTech Q2 FY2026-27 results and interim dividend
IT services demand and AI-driven pricing pressure on Indian IT outsourcers (HCLTech revenue ~$14B in FY26)
Any further promoter share moves between family holding companies (Vama Delhi / HCL Corp) as succession continues
